title: Connected Sociologies
abstract: This book outlines what theory for a global age might look like, positing an agenda for consideration, contestation and discussion, and a framework for the research-led volumes that follow in the series. Gurmider K. Bhambra takes up the classical concerns of sociology and social theory and shows how they are being rethought through an engagement with postcolonial studies, one of the most distinctive critical approaches of the past two decades. She also discusses the significance of the research programme surrounding coloniality and modernity that has emerged recently from Latin America.

Full narrative

Connected Sociologies by Gurminder K. Bhambra was published by Bloomsbury Publishing Plc. in 2014. Conceptually, the work connects to Series (stratigraphy), Epistemology, Sociology, Political science and History.

OpenAlex records 656 citations. That places it in the top 1% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2023 with 86 citing works. Notable citing venues include Sociology, British Journal of Sociology and The Sociological Review. The citing works include 411 journal articles, 168 book chapters and 27 books. They come from 40 countries, led by the United Kingdom, the United States and Germany.

It has been downloaded 4,559 times via OAPEN. Open Library reports a combined count of 1 reading logs and catalog editions.
